thread:
arthur: deploy-bot blocked rc14 GA: SBOM present, vuln-scan clean, but cosign bundle contains unexpected subject (pipeline-rotator). tagging security + signing.
deploy-bot: automated alert: verification failed -> cosign-subject mismatch for redwood/inference:rc14. Policy: signer must be release author or documented delegate. See /artifacts/rc14.
jen: we rotated pipeline keys this morning; packaging used pipeline-rotator service key. I can re-run signing under my user key, but that delays GA ~45m.
mira: CS: we have a limited EU beta waiting this afternoon. any chance for a short scoped carveout?
security-bot: triage: vuln exploitability low. Risk is auditability — we need traceable signer. Options: (1) hold GA until user-signed artifacts, (2) allow a 3h non-enterprise soft-launch if delegation is recorded in approvals and KMS audit + cosign logs attached within 2h.
arthur: can we add delegation entry retroactively in approvals? Is that acceptable to compliance?
security-bot: yes, but must include KMS audit, CI signer rotation timeline, and explicit TTL for delegation. Legal prefers proactive delegation but will accept recorded delegation for emergency carveouts.
jen: I'll run user signing now and open approval AP-1771234000 with delegation note. starting sign job.
signing-bot: queued cosign sign by jen@redwood. ETA ~30m. logs will be posted to https://artifacts.redwood/signatures/rc14/jen-cosign-log.txt.
arthur: plan if signing slips: queue a timeboxed soft-launch for non-enterprise with rollback thresholds: 5% traffic, 2h, rollback on error>1% or p95>2x. deploy-bot supports this scope.
mira: agreed — that keeps momentum. CS will notify beta customers that enterprise deployments are paused until author signature is confirmed.
deploy-bot: soft-launch command preview: ```/publish --image redwood/inference:rc14 --scope non-enterprise --timebox 2h --traffic 5% --rollback_on="error>1%|p95>2x"```
jen: signing completed. cosign log: https://artifacts.redwood/signatures/rc14/jen-cosign-log.txt. KMS audit: https://audit.redwood/kms/rotate/2025-09-07. approval AP-1771234000 updated.
security-bot: verification OK. delegation recorded. GA allowed for all scopes.
arthur: proceeding with GA publish now. command: ```/publish --image redwood/inference:rc14 --scope all --release-notes https://docs.redwood/releases/rc14```
cs-team: enterprise customers notified and unpause message sent.
mira: updating release notes: "RC14: packaging used rotated CI signer; author re-signed artifacts and approval recorded. No vuln findings; enterprise deployments briefly paused."
signing-bot: archival complete. evidence stored in approvals.
arthur: closing thread — thanks for quick turnaround. :white_check_mark:
